questions.title: Which ownership rule must a candidate path pass?
answer: No other task in the plan may produce it: every other task declares a writeScope and none covers the path

questions.title: Where may an overwatcher auto-resolve take the missing file from?
answer: The operator's checkout: the file as committed at the checkout's HEAD, unmodified in the working tree

questions.title: Below dial:critical, is the overwatcher consulted about a missing-resource halt at all?
answer: No: the deterministic halt text already proposes the three commands, so no diagnose is spent

questions.title: Should the terminal gate's halt also name supplied and refreshed content, as the wave gate halts already do?
answer: Yes, in this change: append UnauthoredContentNote to the terminal gate halt's headline and detail
